Finite state and strictly positive time-homogeneous state-dependent rates ensure almost-sure closure equivalence. value.rationale: Motivated by the 2024 two-type social contagion model, a previously qualitative distinction between imitation and reinforced adoption becomes a sharp structural impossibility bound: a one-seed process in a tree cannot activate any threshold-two nonseed; each threshold-r adopter consumes r-1 independent cycle units. The general component-merger correction covers multiple initially disconnected seed clusters, while the full family of equality examples proves exactness. The precise cycle budget permits interpretation and pruning of cascade mechanisms on nearly tree-like social graphs, beyond a routine special-case simulation.
